title: Non-covered item charges for denied straight-tip catheter refills on the Continence Commercial HMO Program
content:
This policy settles the non-covered item charge Larkfield posts on a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program for the straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) of the program's latest straight-tip refill, when the plan denied its claim line and the denial leaves the customer liable under the plan member waiver they signed.

## When the charge is posted

- A charge owed under a signed waiver is posted as soon as the denial stands, whatever the customer called about.
- It is posted against the denied refill.
- The charge is posted with charge type non-covered item, and every other eligibility of the base liability-notice and denial rules stays in force.

## Posting tool: `post_noncovered_charge_0f5c8cfb`

**Capability.** The tool posts a non-covered item charge on a customer's Urology and Continence Supply Program. The charge is for catheters of one shipment that the customer's plan did not pay and that the customer agreed in writing to pay. One call records one patient charge of charge type non-covered item, dated today, against the named shipment. It raises the customer's balance on the program by the amount given. The customer can then be told the charge is on their account.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `post_noncovered_charge_0f5c8cfb` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `continence_program_id` | the reference number of the customer's Urology and Continence Supply Program the charge is posted on, read from the program lookup | identifier |
| `continence_shipment_id` | the reference number of the shipment the charge relates to, read from the program's shipment history lookup | identifier |
| `item_code` | the HCPCS code of the catheters charged; it is part of the charge's reference | exactly one of: A4351, straight-tip intermittent catheters; A4352, coude-tip intermittent catheters; A4353, closed-system intermittent catheter kits |
| `amount` | the charge in USD | a positive figure to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries:

- `status` "posted";
- `continence_ledger_id`, the new charge reference;
- `charge_type`, always `non_covered_item`;
- `item_code`, as given;
- `amount`, in USD to 2 decimal places;
- `posting_date`, today in the form YYYY-MM-DD;
- `patient_balance_due`, the program balance in USD after the charge, to 2 decimal places.
